lines.en: label secondbeach16:
My blister pops and I can sense it filling with stale water and sand particles in place of where my bodily fluids were just moments ago.
lines.zh: 我的水泡破了，我能感觉到它正被陈水和沙粒填满，取代了片刻之前还在那里的我的体液。

lines.en: It stings, but it’s bearable. It just sounds a lot worse when you put it into words.
lines.zh: 很疼，但还能忍。只是用语言说出来，听起来要严重得多。

lines.en: Kind of like a teacher having sex with his students. It’s a lot worse on paper than-
lines.zh: 有点像老师和学生上床。写在纸上可难看多了——

lines.en: Actually, no. It’s still pretty bad either way.
lines.zh: 不，等等。不管怎么说都挺糟的。

lines.en: But I’ve never claimed to be a good person.
lines.zh: 但我从没说过自己是个好人。

lines.en: And it’s not like I’m having sex with any of them {i}right now{/i}, so you can deal with me for another moment or two and pretend I’m better than I actually am.
lines.zh: 而且我{i}现在{/i}又没在跟她们任何一个上床，所以你就再忍我一两分钟，假装我比实际的我更好吧。

lines.en: It’s not like what I do to any of them is eternal either way.
lines.zh: 反正我对她们做的那些事，也都不是永恒的。

lines.en: Once I inevitably fade and someone else slips into this body, so will the memories I was able to inject into them.
lines.zh: 等我有朝一日不可避免地消逝，有别人溜进这具身体，那些我灌进她们身体里的记忆也一样会消失。

lines.en: That isn’t a figure of speech. I’m talking about what I actually inject into them with my penis.
lines.zh: 这不是什么修辞手法。我说的是我真正用鸡巴射进她们体内的东西。

lines.en: And how all of it is just as fleeting as the blister I’ve been walking on.
lines.zh: 以及这一切，都和我一直踩着走的那个水泡一样转瞬即逝。

lines.en: Ephemeral, even.
lines.zh: 甚至可以说，转瞬即灭。

lines.en: What is happening to me?
lines.zh: 我到底是怎么了？

lines.en: scene tryagain2
An ocean appears before me, full of life and...fish.
lines.zh: 一片大海出现在我面前，充满了生命，还有……鱼。

lines.en: But what’s more important is why I’m suddenly, just moments after having a successful conversation with Yumi, a rare feat even to this day-
lines.zh: 但更重要的是，为什么我突然——就在刚和 Yumi 完成了一场成功对话之后，而那即便是到了今天也算是罕见的壮举——

lines.en: Why I’m suddenly thinking about the end.
lines.zh: 为什么我突然开始思考结局。

lines.en: About what will happen after I’m gone.
lines.zh: 思考我消失之后会发生什么。

lines.en: I am me.
lines.zh: 我就是我。

lines.en: I know I’m me.
lines.zh: 我知道我就是我。

lines.en: I’m smart enough to pick up on the hundreds, if not thousands of context clues left by Maya and the Nakayamas that {i}I am real.{/i}
lines.zh: 我足够聪明，能捕捉到 Maya 和 Nakayama 姐妹留下的成百上千条暗示，知道{i}我是真实存在的{/i}。

lines.en: I just...don’t know who {i}I{/i} am.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}只是……不知道我是谁。

lines.en: Which, once again, probably sounds a lot more intense than it actually is.
lines.zh: 而这话说出来，大概又一次比实际情况听起来要深沉得多。

lines.en: I just want to know.
lines.zh: 我只是想知道。

lines.en: But I can’t.
lines.zh: 可我做不到。

lines.en: Now, back to the interesting things in front of me.
lines.zh: 好了，回到我面前这些有趣的东西上吧。

lines.en: : Supreme Overlord, Herald of the Adolescents?
lines.zh: : 至高霸主，青春期的先驱者？

lines.en: scene tryagain3
: What are you doing out here? The majority of the class is having a bonfire.
lines.zh: : 您在这儿做什么？班上大部分人都去参加篝火晚会了。

lines.en: : Hey, Tsuneyo. Who is your friend?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Tsuneyo。你那位朋友是谁？

lines.en: : My only friend is the Emerald Guardian and she is not here right now.
lines.zh: : 我唯一的朋友是翡翠守护者，而她现在不在这儿。

lines.en: : But she insisted that I go out and enjoy myself as she was not feeling up to associating tonight.
lines.zh: : 不过她坚持让我出去玩个尽兴，因为她今晚没心情社交。

lines.en: : And why aren’t {i}you{/i} with the other girls?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}为什么不和其他女生在一起？

lines.en: : I got lost.
lines.zh: : 我迷路了。

lines.en: : But thankfully, I brought this flotation device.
lines.zh: : 不过万幸，我带了这个漂浮装置。

lines.en: : I don’t see how that is going to help you get back to the inn.
lines.zh: : 我看不出这东西怎么能帮你回到旅馆。

lines.en: scene tryagain4
: Hi.
: You really don’t see that thing, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 你真的看不见那个东西吗，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : What thing?
lines.zh: : 什么东西？

lines.en: : The black figure standing beside you with a pink baseball cap on.
lines.zh: : 那个站在你旁边、戴着一顶粉色棒球帽的黑色人影。

lines.en: : It’s actually light purple.
lines.zh: : 其实是淡紫色。

lines.en: scene tryagain3
: I don’t care what color it is. You’re weird. Go away.
lines.zh: : 我管它什么颜色。你很诡异。一边儿去。

lines.en: : I think I understand what is going on here.
lines.zh: : 我想我明白是怎么回事了。

lines.en: : You do?
lines.zh: : 你明白？

lines.en: : You are what my father would call “under the influence.”
lines.zh: : 您就是我父亲所说的「受了影响」。

lines.en: : Have you been drinking the beers again?
lines.zh: : 您是不是又在喝啤酒了？

lines.en: : Not to my knowledge.
lines.zh: : 据我所知没有。

lines.en: : You’ve had so many that you can’t remember having any at all. This is why our family fell apart.
lines.zh: : 您喝得太多了，多到根本记不清自己有没有喝过。我们家就是这么散的。

lines.en: : I think I just might have...food poisoning or something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我可能是……食物中毒之类的。

lines.en: : I’ve been seeing a lot of strange things tonight.
lines.zh: : 我今晚看到了很多奇怪的东西。

lines.en: : Food poisoning does not cause hallucinations, but I’d be open to hearing you describe the things you’ve seen.
lines.zh: : 食物中毒并不会引起幻觉，不过我倒愿意听您描述一下您看到的东西。

lines.en: : I am not a medical professional, but I can pretend that I am interested and make you feel validated as a human being.
lines.zh: : 我不是医疗专业人士，但我可以假装自己很感兴趣，好让您觉得自己作为一个人类被认可了。

lines.en: : Well, like I said, there’s a large, shadowy figure to your left wearing a pink-
lines.zh: : 嗯，就像我说的，你左边有个巨大的黑影，戴着一顶粉色——

lines.en: : Light purple.
lines.zh: : 淡紫色。

lines.en: : ...Light purple hat. And then a bunch of floating fish and a giant rabbit looking thing.
lines.zh: : ……淡紫色的帽子。然后还有一堆飘在空中的鱼，和一只巨大的、像兔子一样的东西。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : That was a joke. I do not see at all.
lines.zh: : 刚才是开玩笑的。我一点都不明白。

lines.en: : Perhaps we just view the world a bit differently from one another.
lines.zh: : 也许只是我们看待世界的方式不太一样吧。

lines.en: : I’m sure we do, but just seeing the world differently isn’t enough to cause things to get this...out of whack.
lines.zh: : 我想是的，但光是看待世界的方式不同，还不足以让事情……乱成这样。

lines.en: : Is it truly “out of whack” if it is what you really see?
lines.zh: : 如果那真的是您所看到的，又怎么能算「乱套」呢？

lines.en: : Just because someone tells you something isn’t there doesn’t mean it’s not.
lines.zh: : 就算有人告诉您某样东西不在那儿，也不代表它真的不在。

lines.en: : Some people are just better at using their eyes than others. For all we know, you are one of those people.
lines.zh: : 有些人就是比别人更会用眼睛。说不定您就是这样的人。

lines.en: : Have you seen anything else?
lines.zh: : 您还看到别的什么了吗？

lines.en: : I’m sure I have, but...the memories of those things are starting to go away.
lines.zh: : 我肯定看到过，不过……关于那些东西的记忆正在开始消失。

lines.en: : To where?
lines.zh: : 消失到哪里去？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Where do memories go once they leave your body?
lines.zh: : 记忆离开身体之后，会去哪儿？

lines.en: : I...don’t think they’re ever really stored {i}in{/i} your body. And they just kind of...disappear, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得它们真的储存在身体{i}里{/i}。它们大概就这么……消失了，我想。

lines.en: : So all the rest of our thoughts stored in...somewhere that is not our bodies-
lines.zh: : 那么我们其余的思绪都储存在……某个不属于我们身体的地方——

lines.en: : Will they vanish when we’re dead and buried and turning into trees?
lines.zh: : 等我们死了、被埋了、变成树之后，它们也会消失吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : But what I do know is that I don’t really want to spend the rest of my night theorizing about death and what comes with it when there is a group of cute girls having a party without me.
lines.zh: : 但我知道的是，在一群可爱的女生正开派对却没带上我的时候，我可不想把今晚剩下的时间都花在推想死亡和随之而来的事情上。

lines.en: : Will you take me with you? I am beginning to fear for my safety alone out here in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 您能带我一起走吗？大半夜一个人待在这种地方，我开始为自己的安全担心了。

lines.en: : And you feel more comfortable with me?
lines.zh: : 跟我在一起你反而更安心？

lines.en: scene tryagain5
: I am beginning to.
lines.zh: : 我开始安心了。

lines.en: : Awwwwwwwwww~
: And...you really don’t see any mysterious...shadowy figure beside you?
lines.zh: : 还有……你真的看不见你旁边那个神秘的……黑影吗？

lines.en: : I do not.
lines.zh: : 看不见。

lines.en: : Just as you don’t see the ones beside you.
lines.zh: : 就像您也看不见您旁边的那些一样。

lines.en: : The what-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: scene tryagain6
: Hey! Sorry I’m late.
lines.zh: : 嘿！抱歉我迟到了。

lines.en: : I ran into a...bit of a situation when I went to get my phone. But it’s all good now!
lines.zh: : 我去拿手机的时候遇到了点……状况。不过现在都好了！

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, no worries. You’re only like...three minutes late anyway, so it’s not like it’s a big deal.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，没事。反正你也就迟到了……三分钟而已，所以也不算什么大事。

lines.en: : Are you sure you wanted to do this instead of going to that bonfire thing, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你确定你想做这个，而不是去参加那个篝火晚会吗？

lines.en: : I don’t really care either way. Just seemed like it might be a little...livelier over there or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我倒是都无所谓。只是觉得那边好像会……热闹一点什么的。

lines.en: scene tryagain7
: I, umm...kind of wanted to be alone with you...if that’s cool...
lines.zh: : 我，嗯……有点想和你单独待着……如果不介意的话……

lines.en: : ...Yeah. Yeah, that’s cool.
lines.zh: : ……嗯。嗯，不介意。

lines.en: : Sorry, it just feels a little different tonight than it normally does when it’s just us.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，只是今晚的感觉，跟平常我们俩单独在一起的时候有点不一样。

lines.en: scene tryagain8
: Like...good different? Or bad different? Or “I actually think Rin is a boy” different?
lines.zh: : 是……好的那种不一样？还是坏的那种不一样？还是「我觉得 Rin 其实是个男生」的那种不一样？

lines.en: : Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: scene tryagain9
: Gah! Shit! I’m already making things awkward!
lines.zh: : 啊！操！我已经开始把气氛搞僵了！

lines.en: : I mean...you kind of make everything ever awkward, so it’s not like I’m not used to it or anything.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你本来就什么都搞得挺僵的，所以我也早就习惯了什么的。

lines.en: : Also, I am well aware that you are a girl.
lines.zh: : 而且我很清楚你是个女生。

lines.en: scene tryagain10
: Ugh...thank God.
lines.zh: : 呃……谢天谢地。

lines.en: : Because earlier, I went through this whole situation thing in my head about what I would do if you {i}didn’t{/i} think that, and the only way I could think of resolving it would be borderline sexual harassment.
lines.zh: : 因为之前我在脑子里演练了一整遍，要是你{i}不{/i}那么想，我该怎么办，而我唯一能想到的解决方式，基本上已经算是性骚扰了。

lines.en: : Soooooo anyway yeah, just ignore me until I start saying normal things again.
lines.zh: : 所以说——总之，在我重新开始说正常话之前，你就当我不存在吧。

lines.en: : I’d probably have to leave altogether if that were the case...
lines.zh: : 要是那样的话，我大概得整个人走掉了……

lines.en: scene tryagain11
: Ah! No! That would make this even worse than last time!
lines.zh: : 啊！不要！那会比上次还糟！

lines.en: : ...Last time?
scene tryagain12
: Hah...
: Okay...here we go...
lines.zh: : 好……那就开始吧……

lines.en: : Rin...hold on a sec...
lines.zh: : Rin……等一下……

lines.en: : Otoha Okakura...
lines.zh: : Otoha Okakura……

lines.en: : I know this might come as a bit of a shock to you...but from the moment I first saw you playing your guitar in the park, I’ve had a major...and I mean like, {i}major{/i} crush on you...
lines.zh: : 我知道这可能会让你有点震惊……但从我在公园里第一次看到你弹吉他的那一刻起，我就对你非常、非常着迷，我是说，{i}着迷得不得了{/i}……

lines.en: scene tryagain13
: That...does not surprise me at all.
lines.zh: : 这……我一点都不意外。

lines.en: : And I know that you aren’t really into the whole dating thing since you’ve turned down basically everyone in Kumon-mi...
lines.zh: : 我也知道你不太喜欢谈恋爱这回事，因为你基本上把 Kumon-mi 的所有人都拒了……

lines.en: : And...honestly, I can’t think of any reason why you wouldn’t turn me down too.
lines.zh: : 而且……说实话，我想不出你有什么理由不把我也拒了。

lines.en: : I’m cute, yeah. But I’m sure there are plenty of other cute people that have confessed to you with...more talent or...or penises.
lines.zh: : 我是挺可爱的，没错。但我敢肯定，向你表白过的可爱的人多了去了，其中还有更有才华的……或者有鸡巴的。

lines.en: : Okay, getting weird now.
lines.zh: : 好了，开始变怪了。

lines.en: : Like, for all I know, you could definitely like penises more than vaginas. And that would be totally okay. In fact, I think they’re kinda cool too.
lines.zh: : 就是说，说不定你就是喜欢鸡巴胜过喜欢阴道。那也完全没关系。事实上，我觉得它们也挺酷的。

lines.en: : A little weird, sure. But still kinda cool.
lines.zh: : 是有点怪，没错。但还是挺酷的。

lines.en: : Uhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : But umm...even if you’re on the penis team instead of my team, I’d still...hate myself if I didn’t go through with this...
lines.zh: : 不过嗯……就算你是鸡巴那队的、而不是我这队的，如果我不把这件事做完，我还是会……恨死自己的……

lines.en: scene tryagain14
: Rin, hold on. I know what you’re about to do and...there's something-
lines.zh: : Rin，等一下。我知道你接下来要说什么，而且……有件事——

lines.en: : The truth is...there isn’t anything that would make me happier right now than...being able to walk down the halls of[school]...holding hands with you and stuff...
lines.zh: : 真相是……现在能让我更开心的事，莫过于……能和你一起走在 [school] 的走廊上……手牵着手什么的……

lines.en: : And maybe kissing under the bleachers occasionally, but we wouldn’t have to do that right away.
lines.zh: : 也许偶尔在看台底下接个吻，不过我们不用马上就做那种事。

lines.en: scene tryagain15
: Oh my God.
lines.zh: : 我的天。

lines.en: : I mean...if you {i}wanted{/i} to do it right away, that would be totally fine too. But...like I said, slow and steady wins the race.
lines.zh: : 我是说……如果你{i}想{/i}马上就做，那也完全没问题。不过……就像我说的，慢工出细活。

lines.en: : Wait, no. I didn’t actually say that. It was in my notes on my phone, but since I forgot where I put it earlier, I-
lines.zh: : 等等，不对。我其实没说那句。那句写在我手机里的备忘里，但我之前忘了手机放哪儿了，所以我——

lines.en: : Actually, forget about the phone. That doesn’t matter right now.
lines.zh: : 算了，别管手机了。那现在不重要。

lines.en: : Rin...come on...
lines.zh: : Rin……拜托……

lines.en: scene tryagain16
: What...
lines.zh: : 什么……

lines.en: : What {i}does{/i} matter is...trying to do something I thought I’d be able to hold off on for a little while longer...
lines.zh: : {i}重要的是{/i}……试着去做一件我本以为还能再拖延一阵子的事……

lines.en: : Because some days, it feels like I’m going to literally explode if I don’t tell you how I feel.
lines.zh: : 因为有些日子，我感觉要是再不把心意告诉你，我就要当场爆炸了。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I can make you happy...Shit, I don’t even really understand what {i}would{/i} make you happy.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己能不能让你幸福……操，我甚至都不太懂什么能让你幸福。

lines.en: : There’s so much I still don’t know about you.
lines.zh: : 关于你，我还有太多不知道的事。

lines.en: : But...the things that I do know...
lines.zh: : 可是……我确实知道的那一点点……

lines.en: : They’re enough to make me want you...
lines.zh: : 已经足够让我想得到你了……

lines.en: scene tryagain17
: More than...anything I’ve ever wanted before...
lines.zh: : 比……我这辈子想要过的任何东西都更想……

lines.en: : So...if you’d...ever have any interest in...you know...being my girlfriend...
lines.zh: : 所以……如果你……有那么一点点兴趣……你知道的……做我女朋友……

lines.en: scene tryagain18
: If...you’d ever have any interest in that...it would make me...happier than anything in the whole wide world.
lines.zh: : 如果……你对那件事有那么一点点兴趣……那会让我……比全世界任何事情都更幸福。

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 好啊。

lines.en: scene tryagain19
: I know it...probably sounds stupid since we’ve only known each other for a few months...
lines.zh: : 我知道……这听起来大概很蠢，毕竟我们才认识几个月……

lines.en: : And I know that you probably need more time to-
lines.zh: : 我也知道你大概需要更多时间——

lines.en: : Wait-
lines.zh: : 等等——

lines.en: scene tryagain20
: What...
lines.zh: : 什么……

lines.en: : What did you just say?...
lines.zh: : 你刚刚说什么？……

lines.en: scene tryagain21
: I said sure.
lines.zh: : 我说好啊。

lines.en: : You really have to get better at listening, dude. I was trying to talk to you that whole time.
lines.zh: : 你真该好好练练听人说话，老兄。我刚刚一直在试图跟你说话。

lines.en: : You...
: Wait, hold on. Just to make sure we’re on the same page right now, you...you know I was asking you out, right?
lines.zh: : 等等，先别急。为了确认我们在同一页上，你……你知道我是在约你出去，对吧？

lines.en: : Uhhhh, yup. You made that pretty clear.
lines.zh: : 呃呃，知道。你说得够清楚了。

lines.en: : And by “Sure,” you mean, “Yes, Rin. I will be your girlfriend?”
lines.zh: : 而你说的「好啊」，意思是「好，Rin。我愿意做你女朋友」？

lines.en: : That is what context would imply, yes.
lines.zh: : 按语境来理解，是的。

lines.en: scene tryagain22
: But...that would mean you like me!
lines.zh: : 可……那意味着你喜欢我！

lines.en: : Yup.
: Which would mean that we like each other!
lines.zh: : 那意味着我们互相喜欢！

lines.en: : Yuuuuup.
: But...no one’s ever liked me at the same time that I’ve liked them before.
lines.zh: : 可……从来没有人在我喜欢她的同时，也喜欢过我。

lines.en: scene tryagain23
: To be honest...I’ve still got a lot of learning to do in that department...
lines.zh: : 说实话……在这件事上，我还有很多要学的……

lines.en: : Like you said, I’ve turned down...tons of people before and never even really...felt bad about any of it.
lines.zh: : 就像你说的，我以前拒绝过……好多人，而且从来没有真的……为其中任何一个感到过愧疚。

lines.en: : And I didn’t even really get how I felt about {i}you{/i} until a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 而我自己也是不久前才真正弄清楚，我对{i}你{/i}到底是怎么想的。

lines.en: : But what I felt wasn’t really...the same sort of thing you feel for me...
lines.zh: : 但我当时感受到的，其实并不是……你对我的那种感情……

lines.en: : I don’t like where this is going.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这话的走向。

lines.en: : Yeah, because you suck at listening. Let me finish.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你听人说话太烂了。让我说完。

lines.en: scene tryagain24
: Rin...you...
lines.zh: : Rin……你……

lines.en: : You do a lot of shit that I’m not really comfortable with.
lines.zh: : 你做了很多让我不太舒服的事。

lines.en: : Like...what?
lines.zh: : 比如……什么？

lines.en: : Is this about...my dep-
lines.zh: : 是因为我的抑——

lines.en: : It’s not about your stupid depression. We can work through that.
lines.zh: : 不是因为你那破抑郁症。那个我们可以一起扛过去。

lines.en: : It’s about how...quickly you started going after me.
lines.zh: : 是因为你……追我追得太快了。

lines.en: : And how hard you fell despite me doing literally nothing.
lines.zh: : 还因为我明明什么都没做，你却陷得那么深。

lines.en: : That shit is noticeable.
lines.zh: : 那种事是看得出来的。

lines.en: : And...the fact that it happened like...{i}right{/i} after you were rejected...
lines.zh: : 而且……那{i}恰好{/i}发生在你被拒绝之后……

lines.en: : I just...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我只是……我不知道。

lines.en: : I guess I never really understood why exactly all of that happened.
lines.zh: : 我想我一直都不太明白，这一切到底为什么会发生。

lines.en: : And I wanted to sort of...clear that up {i}before{/i} something like...this.
lines.zh: : 我想在发生这种事{i}之前{/i}，先把话说清楚。

lines.en: : But...you're like a fuckin' freight train sometimes with how hard your feelings come on.
lines.zh: : 可你有时候就像一列他妈的货运火车，感情来得太猛了。

lines.en: : It's really...intimidating. And unusual.
lines.zh: : 那真的很……吓人。也很不寻常。

lines.en: : And I wanted to be sure that...well, {i}you're{/i} sure.
lines.zh: : 我想确认一下……嗯，{i}你{/i}是不是真的确定。

lines.en: scene tryagain25
: Wait! Do you...
lines.zh: : 等等！你该不会……

lines.en: : Do you think I still like Chika?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得我还喜欢着 Chika？！

lines.en: : Is that why you got all dodgy when we went to the mall?!
lines.zh: : 所以我们去商场的时候你才那么躲躲闪闪的？！

lines.en: : Yeah?...I don’t know?
lines.zh: : 是啊？……我也不知道？

lines.en: : Maybe?
lines.zh: : 也许吧？

lines.en: : It was just...weird seeing you get so emotional about a thing I was finally starting to think you were over.
lines.zh: : 只是……看到你为了一件我好不容易才开始觉得你已经翻篇的事那么激动，感觉挺怪的。

lines.en: scene tryagain26
: Otoha...
lines.zh: : Otoha……

lines.en: : I mean I guess I could be just misunderstanding you, but...I just don’t really understand how things got like {i}this{/i} so quickly.
lines.zh: : 我想也可能是我误会你了，不过……我只是真的不明白事情怎么会发展得{i}这么{/i}快。

lines.en: : And...I was kind of really worried how this would all play out because, now that I’m finally starting to accept how {i}I{/i} feel...I’m...
lines.zh: : 而且……{i}我{/i}其实挺担心这一切会怎么收场的，因为现在我也终于开始接受自己的感情了，我……

lines.en: scene tryagain27
: I’m kind of scared, you know?...
lines.zh: : 我其实有点害怕，你知道吗？……

lines.en: : Like...I don’t want my first experience in dating to be as some...rebound girl or something.
lines.zh: : 就像……我不想让自己第一次谈恋爱，就只是当个什么……疗伤替代品之类的。

lines.en: : I wanted to be like...totally sure it was more than that...
lines.zh: : 我想……完完全全确定，这比那要多得多……

lines.en: scene tryagain28
: Of course it's more than that...
lines.zh: : 当然比那多得多……

lines.en: : It’s true that I liked Chika for a really long time...
lines.zh: : 我喜欢 Chika 喜欢了很久，这是真的……

lines.en: : But I think I always knew in my heart there was no way that was ever going to happen.
lines.zh: : 但我想我心里一直都知道，那件事是永远不可能成真的。

lines.en: : It was just...a childish crush.
lines.zh: : 那只是……一场幼稚的单恋。

lines.en: : But...what if that’s what this is too? We don’t know. We’re like...still [young]or whatever...
lines.zh: : 可……万一这次也是一样呢？我们不知道啊。我们毕竟还……[young] 什么的……

lines.en: scene tryagain29
: Oh, come on! You don’t actually believe all that stuff old people say about being too [young]to understand love, do you?
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托！你不会真信那些老家伙说的「太 [young]、还不懂爱」那套吧？

lines.en: : I mean...I personally don’t understand {i}anything{/i} about love, so...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我个人对爱{i}一窍不通{/i}，所以……

lines.en: : Then...let me take the lead! I have zero experience too, so...we can learn together!
lines.zh: : 那……让我来带路吧！我也零经验，所以……我们可以一起学！

lines.en: : Not just about love, but about each other! About all sorts of things!
lines.zh: : 不只是学怎么去爱，还学彼此！学各种各样的东西！

lines.en: : Okay, but...
lines.zh: : 好，不过……

lines.en: : I need you to promise that it’ll be only me...
lines.zh: : 我要你保证，只有我一个人……

lines.en: scene tryagain30
: You are so cute that I am going to actually die.
lines.zh: : 你可爱得我真的要死了。

lines.en: : Fuck, man. How come writing love songs is so easy but saying this stuff out loud is like, insanely embarrassing?
lines.zh: : 操，老兄。写情歌怎么就那么容易，把这些话说出口却他妈的尴尬得要命？

lines.en: scene tryagain31
: Woah! Where did you come from?
lines.zh: : 哇！你从哪儿冒出来的？

lines.en: : Right next to you.
lines.zh: : 就在你旁边啊。

lines.en: : We’re...really close all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我们……突然靠得好近。

lines.en: : Cause I wanted to be really close to you.
lines.zh: : 因为我想离你很近很近。

lines.en: scene tryagain32
: Well, I mean...since I guess we’re like...you know...dating now or whatever...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我是说……既然我们现在算是……你知道的……在交往了什么的……

lines.en: : It’s okay.
lines.zh: : 那没关系。

lines.en: : Just...take it slow, please. I don’t want to jump right into-
lines.zh: : 只是……请慢慢来。我不想一下子就——

lines.en: scene tryagain33
: Chu~
: Mmf!
lines.zh: : 唔嗯！

lines.en: scene tryagain34
: Sorry, were you saying something?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你刚刚在说什么？

lines.en: : You...
: Um.
: You are very...very bad at listening...
lines.zh: : 你真的……真的很不会听人说话……

lines.en: scene black
scene tryagain35

lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : This is...gonna be a thing we have to tell people about, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这件事……我们得告诉别人，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: If I wake up in ten minutes and this was all some sort of crazy dream, I’m going to kill myself.
lines.zh: : 要是十分钟后我醒过来，发现这一切都是场疯狂的梦，我就去死。

lines.en: : Please don’t say things like that. As your girlfriend, I’m now obligated to care even more.
lines.zh: : 别这么说。作为你女朋友，我现在有义务更关心你了。

lines.en: : I think that’s how these things work, at least. I could be wrong.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这种事应该是这么运作的，至少。我也可能搞错了。

lines.en: scene tryagain36
: But I’m...excited! This was-
lines.zh: : 不过我……很兴奋！这真是——

lines.en: scene tryagain37
: Wait, why are you crying? Did I fuck up already?
lines.zh: : 等等，你为什么在哭？我已经搞砸了吗？

lines.en: : No...Of course not...
lines.zh: : 没有……当然没有……

lines.en: scene tryagain38
: I’m just...really happy...
lines.zh: : 我只是……太开心了……

lines.en: scene tryagain39
: Good.
lines.zh: : 那就好。

lines.en: : I hope you can stay that way.
lines.zh: : 我希望你能一直这样。

lines.en: : The moon is beautiful tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚的月亮真美。

lines.en: scene black
Sometimes, good things happen.
lines.zh: 有时候，好事确实会发生。

lines.en: Not all the time...but if you try enough, something is bound to work eventually.
lines.zh: 不是一直如此……但只要你试得够多，总有什么东西会成功。

lines.en: This was just one of those nights.
lines.zh: 今晚就是那样的夜晚之一。

lines.en: So revel in it while you can because, soon enough, the world will swell with misery once more.
lines.zh: 所以趁还能享受就尽情享受吧，因为很快，这个世界就会再一次被痛苦涨满。

lines.en: Then twice more.
lines.zh: 然后再来一次。

lines.en: Then thrice.
lines.zh: 然后再来一次。

lines.en: Over and over and over again, the clock goes around in circles.
lines.zh: 一遍又一遍又一遍，时钟绕着圈子走。

lines.en: It ticks, it tocks. Repeats. Resets.
lines.zh: 它滴答，它滴答。重复。重置。

lines.en: Because time itself’s eternal.
lines.zh: 因为时间本身是永恒的。

lines.en: Wherever you are, I hope you’re happy.
lines.zh: 无论你在哪里，我都希望你是幸福的。

lines.en: Because God knows that I am not.
lines.zh: 因为天知道，我并不幸福。
